Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the analysis of the second search result. The search results clearly indicate that Will Arnett was married to Penelope Ann Miller from 1994 to 1995 (not 2016) and to Amy Poehler from 2003 to 2016. The Planner incorrectly stated the marriage to Penelope Ann Miller ended in 2016 and that Amy Poehler's marriage ended in 2016, leading to a false conclusion about his current marital status and a confusing final answer regarding who his "spouse" is at the time of the query.
